query:
insert into aarogyam.campaigns (id, name, audience_id, template_id, channel, offer_text,
                                         scheduled_at)
         select $1, $2, a.id, t.id, $5, $6, $7
         from aarogyam.audiences a, aarogyam.message_templates t
         where a.id = $3 and t.id = $4
